label: t28: t25 external effects x1.5, control-fitted gene dispersion x1
claim_type: subjective forecast registered before full generation; no official result

generator.scope_of_scaling: entire saved external effect vector, including embedded own/cis terms; not only recipe amplitude
generator.sampling: new independent gamma-Poisson counts with empirical library-size sampling; no control-cell copies or pinned aggregate

joint_changes: effect scale and gene dispersion, selected by prospective factorial development and disjoint confirmation; D-047; no single-factor causal attribution

expected.calibration: Subjective planning range, not a confidence or prediction interval. Centre discounts the +0.028918 public-context gain by roughly one half; that discount has not been empirically calibrated.
expected.members: Directional fidelity and reach expected to improve; NMAE/Jaccard may worsen; PDS expected near unchanged. Raw MSE expected worse and its scaled value expected to remain clipped at zero.

reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.score >= 0.14523806091483554: Gain >=0.005 over corrected t25: adopt this combination as a promising current-panel reference; no claim of generalization to D/E/F or attribution to one factor.
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.score <= 0.13523806091483553: Loss >=0.005 versus t25: reject this combination as the current recipe improvement; inspect all raw members without moving the threshold.
reading_rule_fixed_before_the_result.otherwise: Inconclusive for the prespecified improvement claim; record any new best observed leaderboard number separately from robustness. Existing recipe remains the reference pending further evidence.

risks: One public HepG2 context, different targets and K562-only source in the bench versus four-source t25 in production.
Independent target split does not make contexts or controls independent replications.
Bootstrap is conditional on observed targets, cells, controls and three seeds; it is not cross-context uncertainty.
t28 includes no learned neural correction; neural routes are evaluated separately.
